answer_text: To avoid VoIP calls using changing egress IPs, enable the Preferred IP for SIP Traffic feature so VoIP/SIP traffic always exits from the same IP. If you have two IPs in a rule, configure it to use a single egress IP (via the Preferred IP setting) and ensure the IP you designate is the one allowed by your SIP trunk. Steps: account-wide: Resources > Advanced Configuration; site-wide: Network > Sites, select the site and enable the Preferred IP for SIP Traffic (or the equivalent advanced setting). After enabling, reset IP phones if needed and monitor for continued calls; note that if the chosen egress IP becomes unavailable during PoP maintenance, traffic may be dropped until the IP is reachable again.
